availability: independent Bernoulli draw at start of each trial; state remains fixed across collection and recovery
recovery_route: reverse of collection route, starting after final aggregation
selection: during ciphertext collection, online TMs that establish an in-range contact form the set known to CC; CC uniformly selects exactly t from this set before recovery; selection and discovery overhead are not charged
metric: all selected t request-response transfers complete before the recovery route ends; transport feasibility, not cryptographic correctness
service: equal-share half-duplex unicast among selected terminals in contact; symmetric link budget; partial transfers resume; no headers, crypto delays, or leftover-share redistribution within timestep
